card.name: Postal codes and phone numbers in addresses
card.fires_on: Digits, spaces and brackets inside street addresses, postal codes and phone numbers, mostly in contact details for organizations. Also weakly on place names in lists of London localities.

modes.label: Lists of place names
modes.description: Linking words or commas in a list of neighbouring localities.
